description: Surfaces Fibery work items whose public ID is a round number, with an assignee podium and filters by type, owner, and date. Shows every item whose public ID is one non-zero digit followed by at least three zeros — 1000, 5000, 10 000, 100 000, and so on — across Technical Tasks, Studies, Bugs, Actions, and Internal Goals. An all-time podium ranks the top three assignees by item count. Three independent filters narrow the list by item type, creation date (last 24 h, week, or month), and owner.
